analysis.study_scope: Full carabiner modeling workflow: body construction from a plane, gate and holder assemblies, knurling, proportion/silhouette, topology, modifier and shading decisions, and final target appearance.

episodes.problem: Drafting the basic 2D carabiner body silhouette.
episodes.observed_fact: Plane added, rotated 90 deg, faces deleted, vertices positioned and bevelled.
episodes.instructor_claim: Shape vertices like an ear outline, then bevel vertices.
episodes.interpretation: Deleting plane faces creates a clean 2D path for vertex beveling.
episodes.hypothesis: Bezier curves could be used, but vertex beveling on mesh edges offers direct control.
episodes.reference_evidence: Plane faces deleted leaving 2D edge profile in Edit Mode.
episodes.modeling_decision: Delete plane faces and bevel corner vertices to build the outline path.
episodes.visible_action: Deletes faces with X, drags vertices into shape, applies vertex bevel with Ctrl+Shift+B.
episodes.spoken_reason: Straighten the right vertex and bevel vertices to form a curved ear shape.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Generates a smooth 2D vertex path with rounded turns.
episodes.alternatives: Draw path directly with Bezier curves.
episodes.transferable_principle: Stripping faces from 2D primitive meshes allows fast curve layout using vertex beveling.

episodes.problem: Sweeping a uniform 3D tube along the 2D profile path.
episodes.observed_fact: Mesh converted to curve, Depth value increased in curve settings, re-converted to mesh, and straight section separated.
episodes.instructor_claim: Convert mesh to curve, increase depth, convert back to mesh.
episodes.interpretation: Curve bevel depth instantly generates consistent circular geometry along complex paths.
episodes.hypothesis: Skin modifier could work but provides less uniform radial topology.
episodes.reference_evidence: Curve Properties panel -> Geometry -> Bevel -> Depth adjustment.
episodes.modeling_decision: Leverage curve bevel depth for instant solid body generation.
episodes.visible_action: Converts mesh to curve, increases Depth, converts back to mesh, adds loop cuts with Ctrl+R, separates gate section with P.
episodes.spoken_reason: Increase geometry depth on curve panel then convert back to mesh.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Produces a cylindrical tube mesh following the ear silhouette.
episodes.failure: Initial depth value caused geometry clipping.
episodes.correction: Adjusted depth down to appropriate tube thickness.
episodes.alternatives: Use Skin modifier or Extrude along path.
episodes.transferable_principle: Converting paths to curves and adjusting bevel depth is an efficient method to generate tubular meshes.

episodes.problem: Controlling surface sharpness and organic body thickness under subdivision.
episodes.observed_fact: Subdivision Surface modifier applied. Vertices slid along edges using double-G to bring edge loops closer together.
episodes.instructor_claim: Bringing 3 edge loops close together creates sharp ridges under subdivision.
episodes.interpretation: Loop proximity governs local curvature sharpness under Catmull-Clark subdivision.
episodes.hypothesis: Crease weights could sharpen edges but produce harsher shading transitions.
episodes.reference_evidence: Subdivision Surface modifier active while sliding vertices with GG.
episodes.modeling_decision: Slide adjacent edge loops together to sharpen specific ridge lines while maintaining organic flow.
episodes.visible_action: Slids vertices using GG, toggles modifier Edit Mode visibility.
episodes.spoken_reason: Slide vertices close to each other creating three segment edges to form a sharp edge.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Creates sharp ridges and variable thickness along the body.
episodes.alternatives: Use Bevel modifier or Edge Crease.
episodes.transferable_principle: Controlling distance between parallel supporting edge loops fine-tunes surface sharpness under subdivision.

episodes.problem: Closing open pipe ends and forming interlocking joint tips.
episodes.observed_fact: LoopTools Circle applied to tip loop. Open face filled (F), middle vertices connected (J), face extruded along normals (Alt+E), edges bevelled.
episodes.instructor_claim: Use LoopTools circle to make perfectly circular open tips, then extrude and bevel.
episodes.interpretation: Regularizing boundary loops into clean quad grids allows precise boxy extrusions from circular ends.
episodes.hypothesis: Grid fill alone would not create flat faces suitable for cubic tip extrusions.
episodes.reference_evidence: LoopTools menu and vertex join operations on screen.
episodes.modeling_decision: Convert round opening to quad grid, extrude cubic caps, and bevel corner edges.
episodes.visible_action: Applies LoopTools Circle, fills face (F), splits quads with J, extrudes with Alt+E, bevels with Ctrl+B.
episodes.spoken_reason: Ensure tip edge is circular, fill face, join middle vertices for square shape, and extrude.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Transitions round pipe ends into bevelled square locking tips.
episodes.transferable_principle: Regularizing open cylindrical ends to quad grids enables seamless transitions to boxy mechanical geometry.

episodes.problem: Creating slotted end joints on the gate cylinder to receive body tips.
episodes.observed_fact: Gate cylinder scaled, loop cuts added, middle faces deleted, boundary edge loops bridged/filled, outer edges bevelled.
episodes.instructor_claim: Scale gate along Z-axis for offset, add loop cuts, delete middle faces, fill hollow shape.
episodes.interpretation: Deleting central faces and bridging boundary loops creates clean mechanical slot cutouts.
episodes.hypothesis: Boolean subtraction could make slots but risks messy topology.
episodes.reference_evidence: Face deletion and edge loop bridging visual sequence on gate mesh.
episodes.modeling_decision: Cut out top and bottom slots by deleting face pairs and refilling open loop borders.
episodes.visible_action: Scales on Z, inserts loop cuts, deletes faces, selects boundary loops and fills with F, bevels edges.
episodes.spoken_reason: Add loop cuts near connection, delete faces, and fill hollow shape by pressing F.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Forms slotted recessed sockets on gate mesh.
episodes.alternatives: Boolean subtract body tips from gate mesh.
episodes.transferable_principle: Manual face deletion and loop bridging maintains clean low-poly quad topology for mechanical sockets.

episodes.problem: Modeling realistic hinge pin hardware across the joint.
episodes.observed_fact: 8-vertex cylinder added, scaled down, placed at hinge joint, end faces bevelled, subdivision modifier applied.
episodes.instructor_claim: Add cylinder with 8 vertices, scale down tiny, place at connection, bevel end faces, subsurf.
episodes.interpretation: Combining low-poly 8-sided cylinders with Subdivision Surface creates smooth fastener caps efficiently.
episodes.hypothesis: Using a high-poly cylinder directly would needlessly inflate scene polycount.
episodes.modeling_decision: Use low-poly cylinder primitive paired with subdivision modifier for pin hardware.
episodes.visible_action: Adds 8-vert Cylinder, scales and aligns to joint, bevels end faces with Ctrl+B, adds Subsurf.
episodes.spoken_reason: Add cylinder with only 8 vertices, scale down, place at connection, bevel faces and subsurf.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Produces smooth rounded pin caps resting in joint recesses.
episodes.alternatives: Model pin integrated directly into gate mesh.
episodes.transferable_principle: Subdividing low-vertex primitives (8-sided cylinders) yields clean curved mechanical fasteners.

episodes.problem: Constructing layered concentric locking sleeves around the gate.
episodes.observed_fact: Edge loops duplicated from gate, separated (P), extruded along normals (Alt+E), inner faces deleted, outer edges bevelled.
episodes.instructor_claim: Duplicate face loop, separate, extrude along normal, delete inner unused faces.
episodes.interpretation: Deriving sleeves directly from underlying mesh guarantees perfect concentric fit.
episodes.hypothesis: Creating a separate cylinder from scratch requires manual radius alignment.
episodes.reference_evidence: Duplicate (Shift+D), Separate (P), Extrude Along Normals (Alt+E) shown on screen.
episodes.modeling_decision: Duplicate underlying gate loops to generate fitting concentric sleeve collars.
episodes.visible_action: Shift+D to duplicate loop, P to separate, Alt+E extrude along normals, deletes interior faces, bevels border edges.
episodes.spoken_reason: Duplicate and separate panel, extrude along normal, scale on Z, delete inner face.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Creates layered concentric mechanical collars surrounding gate.
episodes.alternatives: Add new cylinder primitive and manually snap scale.
episodes.transferable_principle: Duplicating and extruding underlying base topology guarantees perfect fit for concentric mechanical sleeves.

episodes.problem: Generating diamond knurling patterns on the sleeve without modeling complex geometry.
episodes.observed_fact: Sleeve seam marked and UV unwrapped. Brick Texture node added, mapping rotated 45 deg on Z, offset set to 1, mortar size/smooth adjusted, routed through ColorRamp and Bump node to Normal input.
episodes.instructor_claim: Rotate Brick Texture node 45 degrees via Mapping node and feed into Bump to create procedural knurling.
episodes.interpretation: Rotating square brick patterns 45 degrees yields diamond knurling surface bump maps.
episodes.hypothesis: Modeling knurling geometry directly would explode polycount and impede adjustments.
episodes.reference_evidence: Shader Editor node setup: UV -> Mapping (Rot Z=45°) -> Brick Texture -> ColorRamp -> Bump -> Normal.
episodes.modeling_decision: Drive normal bump mapping via 45-degree rotated Brick Texture for non-destructive knurling.
episodes.visible_action: Marks UV seam, unwraps, adds Brick Texture, sets Mapping Z Rotation = 45°, adjusts mortar settings, connects Bump to Normal.
episodes.spoken_reason: Add brick texture, connect UV mapping, change Z rotation to 45 degrees, plug into bump height.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Simulates diamond grip texture on smooth base mesh.
episodes.failure: Default generated texture coordinates distorted pattern wrapping.
episodes.correction: Switched Texture Coordinate from Generated to UV and enabled Keep Corners on Subsurf modifier.
episodes.alternatives: Displacement modifier with height map or modeled physical geometry.
episodes.transferable_principle: Rotating structured procedural pattern shaders 45 degrees generates clean diamond knurling maps.
